hits.name: Wool Trail Neck Gaiter
hits.description: This oatmeal wool neck gaiter from Waybound is a lightweight, packable essential for cool-weather mountain adventures. Soft merino wool construction keeps you warm without bulk, making it easy to stash in your pack for layering on the trail.
hits.imagePrompt: Hiker wearing oatmeal wool neck gaiter in misty mountain setting, packable and draped casually around neck, cool weather gear.

hits.name: Lightweight Wool Trail Scarf
hits.description: The Waybound Lightweight Wool Trail Scarf in moss is a versatile layering piece that packs down small for hiking and travel while keeping you warm in cool conditions. Made from breathable wool, this lightweight scarf works as a neck warmer, head covering, or emergency blanket on the trail.
hits.imagePrompt: Draped women's lightweight wool trail scarf in moss green, packable and compact, styled on outdoor adventurer against natural landscape.
